title: Downstream
subject: geography
author: Clueberry Desk
introduction: Nine entries that all end up at the sea.

entries.clue: Wide loop cut by a slow current
European waterway that passes four national capitals
River carrying more water than any other
Longest river in Europe, draining to the Caspian
Spring at the very top of the system
African river with the deepest soundings on record
Side you stand on, or somewhere to keep money

factCards.text: The Danube passes Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and Belgrade, more national capitals than any other river.
factCards.sourceTitle: International Commission for the Protection of the Danube River

factCards.text: The Volga runs about 3,530 kilometres and empties into the Caspian Sea, which has no outlet to the ocean.
Surveys of the lower Congo have recorded depths beyond 200 metres, deeper than any other river measured.
factCards.sourceTitle: Published depth soundings of the lower Congo; figures vary between surveys
